about.heading: About Me
about.p1: Hey! I'm Hassaan — a web developer who helps small businesses get real results online: more calls, more bookings, more customers. I love turning ideas into products people actually enjoy using.
about.p2: I build complete, modern websites with tools like React, Node.js, and MongoDB — fast, mobile-friendly, and easy to find on Google. No jargon, no surprises: you get a fixed price, a fixed launch date, and a site you're proud to share.
about.p3: Here are a few technologies I work with:

contact.emailMe: Prefer email? Write to me directly.
contact.paragraph: Want a website that brings your business more customers? Let's talk for 20 minutes — I'll tell you honestly what's possible for your business, no pressure and no jargon.

hero.heading2: I build websites that bring your business more customers.
hero.paragraph: I help small businesses get more calls, bookings, and sales with fast, modern websites — fixed price, live in 14–21 days, and zero tech headaches for you.

descriptions.dentment: A mentorship and business-education platform for dental professionals — 2,500+ dentists learning from expert mentors through video courses and a private community.
descriptions.easyturf: Online booking for sports turf facilities — players reserve fields in seconds and owners manage bookings and schedules in one place. No phone tag, no double-bookings.
descriptions.oneStopFrontend: An all‑in‑one frontend toolkit that demonstrates modern UI patterns and responsive layouts. It emphasises clean component architecture, modular styling, and accessibility best practices. The project was built with reusability in mind so new pages can be added with minimal effort.
descriptions.oxygym: Class bookings and membership management for a gym — members book classes, track workouts, and manage memberships online, while staff see live class availability. Proof that online booking keeps customers coming back.
